environment.description: Spring Boot service deployed on EC2 behind an internet-facing ALB with public DNS (tokens-api.acme.io). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. The /debug/encrypt endpoint is accessible. Any internet client can call the API, obtain ciphertexts for chosen plaintexts, and forge tokens with arbitrary user_id and scope by exploiting the static key + static IV reuse.
